Generalized grid data set reflecting coral reef locations at 500 m resolution. Reef locations are based on 500 meter resolution gridded data reflecting shallow, tropical coral reefs of the world.

Generalized grid data set reflecting coral reef locations at 500 m resolution. Reef locations are based on 500 meter resolution gridded data reflecting shallow, tropical coral reefs of the world. The composite data set was compiled from multiple sources, incorporating products from the Millennium Coral Reef Mapping Project prepared by IMaRS/USF and IRD. Dataset last updated April 2011. Title from https://datasets.wri.org/dataset/tropical-coral-reefs-of-the-world-500-m-resolution-grid ; viewed on August 22, 2024.
